name: Pointerless Octree for Seed Placement
aliases: Pyramid Data Structure for Seed Points
Pyramidal data structure for seed points
definition: A pointerless octree used to efficiently find volume cells for seed point placement at runtime, avoiding pre-generation of all seeds to minimize memory.
summary: Pointerless Octree for Seed Placement is a memory-efficient method that dynamically selects volume hatching seeds using a hierarchical pyramid structure to prune empty or planar regions early in traversal.
